units.source_text: 整日待在屋內實在讓我覺得煩悶，於是，又像以往一樣，常常到外面喝廉價酒。

en.t: Staying shut indoors all day made me unbearably restless, so, just as before, I often went out to drink cheap liquor.

units.source_text: 但自從發生那次安眠藥事件後，我的身體明顯消瘦了許多，手腳無力，連畫漫畫都提不起精神。

en.t: But after that sleeping-pill incident, my body grew noticeably thinner, my limbs felt weak, and I could not even summon the energy to draw cartoons.

units.source_text: 比目魚當時來探望我留下了一筆慰問金（「這是我的一點心意」，

en.t: When Flatfish came to visit me then, he left some money as a get-well gift, saying, "This is just a small token from me,"

units.source_text: 聽比目魚的口氣，這些錢好像是他掏腰包拿出來的，

en.t: From Flatfish's tone, it seemed as though he had taken the money out of his own pocket,

units.source_text: 其實不然，這是老家哥哥們寄來的錢。

en.t: but that was not the truth; it was money sent by my elder brothers back home.

units.source_text: 這個時候，我已不是當初逃離比目魚家時的我了，

en.t: By then, I was no longer the same person I had been when I first ran away from Flatfish's house.

units.source_text: 能隱隱約約地看穿他裝模作樣的表演，

en.t: I had become able, however dimly, to see through his affected performance,

units.source_text: 所以我也狡猾地裝出什麼也不知道，向他道謝。

en.t: so I too craftily pretended that I knew nothing at all and thanked him.
